name: millimore-streaming-engine
description: Millimore Streaming Engine — a separate helper process built on the OBS engine (obs-studio-node / libobs). The closed-source Millimore app controls it over a local WebSocket. Kept a separate process for GPL license separation.

comments.obs-studio-node: NOT installable from the public npm registry. It is distributed by Streamlabs as prebuilt binaries pinned to a specific Electron version. See README.md → Provisioning. It is declared optional so `npm install` here never fails; the code resolves it at runtime.
